# WASP-121 b: provisional composite at the planet's orbit
# columns: wavelength [A]  flux at the planet [erg cm^-2 s^-1 A^-1]
# status:   PROVISIONAL COMPOSITE. Solar XUV shape below 1700 A at the
#           F_XUV = 1.60e+06 erg cm^-2 s^-1 (lambda < 912 A, Salz et al. 2019,
#           A&A 623, A57) normalization Huang et al. (2023), ApJ 951, 123
#           (2023ApJ...951..123H) section 2.2 prescribe; WASP-17 (F6V,
#           MUSCLES v24) photosphere above 1700 A as a proxy for WASP-121
#           (T_eff, gravity and line blanketing are the proxy's, not the
#           target's). NOT a reproduction of the Huang et al. spectrum:
#           their LLmodels synthetic spectrum above 1700 A is unavailable.
# part 1:   lambda < 1700 A, the solar SED of candidate A
#           (wasp121b_solar_huang2023.txt): Solar Irradiance Reference
#           Spectrum of the 2008 Whole Heliosphere Interval (Woods et al.
#           2009, GRL 36, L01101), column 'March 30 - April 4', irradiance
#           at 1 au, x 5.387291e+05 so that F(1-912 A) = 1.6000e+06 erg cm^-2 s^-1 at
#           the planet, with the Lya window 1206.0-1226.0 A carrying its line
#           above the local continuum x 2.961511e-02 so that the line flux is
#           1.000e+05 erg cm^-2 s^-1 (both Huang section 2.2).
# part 2:   lambda >= 1700 A, the photosphere of candidate B
#           (wasp121b_wasp17_huang2023.txt): MUSCLES v24 const-res
#           broadband SED of WASP-17 (F6V), flux at Earth (France et al.
#           2016, 2016ApJ...820...89F; Behr et al., MUSCLES Extension),
#           HST/STIS G230L and G430L plus a PHOENIX photosphere,
#           x 1.206591e+19 so that the bolometric flux at the planet is
#           sigma T_eff^4 (R_star/a)^2 = 7.002775e+09 erg cm^-2 s^-1 with
#           T_eff = 6459 K, R_star = 1.4572 R_sun and a = 0.02544 au (Huang
#           Table 1); BOLOFLUX = 5.803769e-10 erg cm^-2 s^-1 from the FITS
#           primary header. 0 source rows below zero set to 0.
# join:     NEITHER component is renormalized to force continuity at
#           1700 A; each keeps the published normalization of its own
#           band. Measured step f(1700.0 A)/f(1699.5 A) = 0.1324; measured band
#           ratio F(1700-1750 A)/F(1650-1700 A) = 0.4272.
# bins:     both components are 1 A bin averages (the WHI rows sit at the
#           centres of its 1 A intervals; the MUSCLES const-res product
#           states WAVELENGTH0/WAVELENGTH1 edges with FLUX the average
#           over the bin). The composite keeps 1 A rows and is a bin
#           average throughout.
# units:    WHI W m^-2 nm^-1 x 100 = erg cm^-2 s^-1 A^-1; the MUSCLES
#           product is already erg cm^-2 s^-1 A^-1.
# coverage: 0.5000 to 5000.0000 A, 5001 rows, strictly increasing.
# built by inputdata/sed/build/build_wasp121b_composite.py
